name: AVENUE
full: European ecosystems for Audiovisual Education and Training Network for European Vocational Excellence
desc: Developed five leading ecosystems across Europe to build stronger bridges between education, industry, and innovation in the creative visual sector.

name: VPSN2
desc: Builds on the VPSN initiative, expanding its scope to meet the evolving needs of Virtual Production education and industry practice. Funded by the Erasmus+ programme to advance accessible, industry-focused, and sustainable VP training for educators and students.

name: KreativEU
full: Long-term institutional, structural and strategic cooperation on Europe's cultural heritage
desc: A funded European Alliance on Europe's cultural heritage. Carlos co-leads the work package on Sustainability of AI in the European context, across an alliance of 11 European universities.

name: VPSN
desc: An Erasmus+ project supporting institutions to integrate Virtual Production in their programmes, by developing open research, training and educational materials related to VP practices for educators and students.

name: AICI
desc: Assessing the opportunities and challenges of generative AI and its implications for the Creative Digital Industry, including the development of a Generative Storyboard AI tool.

name: Procedural Ocean
full: Auto-generated 3D environments for offshore energy planning and decision-making
desc: A pilot in automatically generating 3D environments in Unreal based on real geo-data concerning offshore energy, biology and environments, to aid the learning, policy- and decision-making process of planners and stakeholders of offshore areas.

name: PlanV
full: Virtual production pre-visualisation with Painting Practice
desc: A professional tool to support film and television professionals to iterate on set design, cameras, lighting, and animation, reducing production costs while increasing efficiency. Used on His Dark Materials (BBC/HBO) and Wednesday (Netflix).

name: Bound to the Miraculous
full: Simulated ocean environment in Unreal Engine 5
desc: Led the creation of a simulated ocean environment in Unreal Engine 5, inspired by Bas Jan Ader's 1975 voyage.

name: VIBE
full: Realistic animated face avatars based on 3D photogrammetry for medical education
desc: Financed by the European Union, OPZuid, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Province of Noord-Brabant and Municipality of Tilburg through a 7 million euro Regional Strategy and Innovation Grant, to develop highly realistic and engaging animated human face avatars based on 3D photogrammetry for medical education.

name: MSP Challenge
desc: A multi-awarded European and national funded serious game on Maritime Spatial Planning focused on international collaboration, using simulation based on real data, for the Clyde Estuary, Baltic Sea, North Sea, Adriatic Sea and Eastern Mediterranean.

name: Smart City Hospitality
desc: A European Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme to develop a digitally augmented board game, to evaluate policies and key performance indicators of city tourism.

name: GURaaS
full: Game User Research as a Service
desc: A web-based player experience evaluation platform which allows researchers and developers to remotely collect and analyse in-game behaviour.

name: Dancer Awakens
full: First Augmented Reality short movie using the HoloLens
desc: Showcased at Go Short — International Short Film Festival of Nijmegen.

name: Green Bubbles Dive
full: Underwater Virtual Reality experience based on a real diving site
desc: A Horizon 2020 project where an underwater Virtual Reality experience based on a real diving site was developed using photogrammetry.
